limitations: One plan per arm; no model variance or client-family comparison

Routing fixtures1–6 contained expectation metadata; workers were instructed to use only q/descriptions, so this is not blind routing evidence

No full historical task-execution suite was rerun; unchanged scenarios retain their dated evidence

initial.observation: Broad new description over-selected trivial style and framework tasks; some unrelated supporting skills were also preloaded.

final.observation: Fresh q-only context used a narrower capability/compatibility/review description and an explicit smallest-entrypoint selection instruction.

existingRouting.changes: Narrowed the new description and skipped token/style tweaks and mechanical framework refactors. Existing case expectations and other skill descriptions stayed unchanged.
existingRouting.limits: The final selection instruction also changed; do not attribute every routing difference to the description. No historical task execution result was relabelled.
